header.title: Impersonation
header.description: Every impersonation token issued by the server is tracked here. Active grants can be revoked — the token is rejected by the JWT validation hook within seconds.
empty.noActiveDesc: When an operator starts impersonating a tenant user, the session appears here in real time.
empty.noMatchDesc: Try a different status filter to see the rest of the grant history.
dialog.title: Request read-only access
dialog.descConfigure: the user approves or denies your request in the dashboard.
dialog.pick.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, or username…
dialog.configure.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Customer ticket #4821 — verifying ledger discrepancy
dialog.configure.reasonHelp: Recorded in the security audit trail — be specific enough that a reviewer can reconstruct the case later.
dialog.configure.warningStrong: The user is asked first, and you can only read.
dialog.configure.warningRest: The user sees your name and the reason, and can deny the request or end the impersonation at any time. Every change you try is refused; the audit trail shows both the user and you as the actor.
dialog.toast.requestedDesc: {{name}} is asked to approve it. Start the impersonation from the tenant's access requests once they do.
revokeDialog.title: Revoke impersonation grant
revokeDialog.description: The issued token will be rejected on the next authenticated request (within ~1 second of cache TTL). The session in the dashboard tab is killed without warning.
revokeDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Operator left for lunch; ending session
revokeDialog.reasonHelp: Recorded on the grant and in the security audit trail.
revokeDialog.toast.revokedDesc: Token for {{name}} will be rejected on the next request.
card.title: Active impersonations
card.description: Operators reading as users in this tenant. Revoking immediately invalidates the issued token; the dashboard tab will 401 on its next request.
requests.title: Access requests
requests.description: Your requests for read-only access to this tenant's users. The user approves or denies each one; an approved request starts once, within 24 hours.
requests.toast.startedDesc: Opened the dashboard as {{name}}. End it from the dashboard tab.
